candidate_workaround: Inspect the two-character Git porcelain status field literally instead of using wildcard matching.
failure_signature: A bounded status summary used the PowerShell wildcard pattern ??* for untracked rows, so every two-or-more-character status line was falsely counted as untracked.
recurrence_guard: For porcelain v1, identify untracked rows with a literal prefix comparison such as StartsWith('??').
rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness with zero credit, and leave all external and protected-gate state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Same-owner skill initialization recovery only; not independent reproduction or broader assurance.
